biomarkers.name: Plasma / urine fractionated metanephrines and normetanephrines
biomarkers.prevalence: Typically elevated in functional tumors; marked elevation (commonly >=2�d7 ULN) strongly supports diagnosis
biomarkers.clinical_use: First-line diagnostic test. Plasma-free metanephrines have highest sensitivity

biomarkers.name: Chromogranin A
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supportive; also elevated in other NETs

biomarkers.name: SDHB IHC / SDHx mutations (SDHA/B/C/D/AF2)
biomarkers.prevalence: SDHx alterations account for a substantial subset of hereditary PPGL; SDHB is the SDHx gene most associated with metastatic risk
biomarkers.clinical_use: SDHB loss on IHC screens for SDHx-related disease (except some SDHA-mutant tumors, which may require SDHA IHC as well). SDHB mutations confer the highest risk of metastatic disease; useful for hereditary risk assessment and family screening

biomarkers.name: Genetic panel (SDHA/B/C/D, VHL, RET, NF1, TMEM127, MAX, FH, MDH2, GDNF, EPAS1/HIF2A, etc.)
biomarkers.prevalence: ~30-40% of pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma patients have an identifiable germline pathogenic variant
biomarkers.clinical_use: Guide screening for syndromic associations (MEN2, VHL, NF1, hereditary paraganglioma). Determine risk of malignancy and other tumours

biomarkers.name: SSTR2
biomarkers.prevalence: Frequently positive, particularly in paragangliomas and many metastatic SDHx-related tumors
biomarkers.clinical_use: DOTATATE PET is highly sensitive for staging and detection of metastatic disease; PRRT considered in metastatic disease

biomarkers.name: MIBG (123I-MIBG) avidity
biomarkers.prevalence: Often positive in pheochromocytoma; avidity is lower in some metastatic, dedifferentiated, and SDHx-related tumors
biomarkers.clinical_use: Staging; 131I-MIBG therapy for MIBG-avid metastatic disease

biomarkers.name: PASS score (Pheochromocytoma of the Adrenal gland Scaled Score)
biomarkers.clinical_use: PASS >=4 suggests adverse potential, but reproducibility and predictive accuracy are limited; metastasis remains the only definitive criterion for malignancy

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Nests ('Zellballen' architecture) of chromaffin cells with basophilic granular cytoplasm, surrounded by sustentacular (S100+) cells
histomorphological_subtype.grading: PASS and GAPP scoring systems; no reliable histologic malignancy predictor  'malignant' pheochromocytoma is defined by metastasis to sites where chromaffin tissue is normally absent

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Characteristic 'Zellballen' architecture with delicate vascular network; sustentacular cells at nest periphery (S100+)

cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Neural crest  sympathetic ganglion precursors that migrate to adrenal medulla
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Retains chromaffin cell differentiation (chromogranin+, synaptophysin+) with catecholamine production; nested (zellballen) pattern with sustentacular S100+ cells at nest periphery (parallels paraganglioma and olfactory neuroblastoma)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Major molecular groups include pseudohypoxia cluster (SDHx, VHL, EPAS1/HIF2A, FH  HIF pathway activation, more aggressive), kinase signalling cluster (RET, NF1, TMEM127, MAX, HRAS  MAPK/PI3K pathway activation), and a less common Wnt-altered subgroup (including MAML3 fusion)
